title: One picture: who replies to whom

focus.title: 81 people, 120 pairs who answered each other more than once
focus.ask: The graph is back, as the reply network among people — the form a node-link diagram earns, since an edge here is a real relationship. Names are on it. Dark blue holds standing, light blue has a Datatracker record, grey has none. Is this the one picture, or is it still not the thing you need to see?

focus.title: The three busiest accounts hold no standing
focus.ask: Iman Schrock (110 messages), Chris Hood (71) and Muhammad Usama Sardar (41) all resolve to a Datatracker person but match no standing clause. Adrian Farrel at 28 is the first with standing. Does that match how the list feels to read?

focus.title: 444 of 603 pairs replied to each other exactly once
focus.ask: Drawing every one of those put 204 people in a single unreadable disc, so the default shows only pairs who answered each other twice or more. Is a repeated exchange the right definition of a relationship here, or does one reply already count?
